plain_italian_summary: Questa policy definisce come dovranno funzionare le API key di produzione, ma non genera chiavi reali e non abilita accessi live. L'emissione di chiavi produzione resta bloccata fino ad approvazione proprietario e passaggio dei gate commerciali.

key_classes.purpose: Safe sandbox testing with synthetic data and limited credits.
Future paid live customer usage after fiscal, legal, payment, privacy and cost gates.
Owner/agent administrative operations, never exposed in public docs.
Test-mode payment/webhook simulations without real payments.

never_store_or_publish: customer personal data in key metadata

immediate_revocation_triggers: key appears in browser screenshot or public document
real data detected during test mode
revocation_actions: stop write calls for affected key
preserve audit record with prefix only
do not retry failed costly operations
rotation_actions: create replacement key only after owner-approved gate
invalidate old key after overlap window
verify no public artifact contains full key

public_documentation_rules: Public docs may show prefixes but never full keys.
Examples must use placeholders such as {{machinesignal_api_key}}.
Postman environments must keep secret values blank.
OpenAPI may document security scheme but not real credentials.
GitHub must never contain production or admin keys.

automatic_actions: stop write-capable flows for suspected key
scan public artifacts for secret-like values
notify owner with exact decision needed
owner_decision_needed: approve revocation if key is real
approve replacement key if live customer exists
approve disclosure response if third party is affected

remaining_blockers: no production key storage implementation validated

recommended_next_action.name: production_api_key_policy_probe_and_secret_scan
recommended_next_action.plain_italian: Validare la policy e fare una secret scan dei documenti pubblici/locali per verificare che non ci siano chiavi reali o valori sensibili.
